description: Fork of exp727 (E=384, NAP-bump, Tiny hybrid_smooth_autograd n_alt=1). Swaps TinyMultiHeadLut throughout for FastMultiHeadLUT(forward_mode='hard', backward_mode='ball'). Forward gathers 1 row per table via F.embedding_bag('sum') — pure argmax, no top-2 blend, no temps in forward. Backward uses NAP+1 Hamming-1 ball softmax surrogate (K-wide Z einsum computed once, immediately gathered to (NAP+1) cols; subsequent softmax/derivation arithmetic at width R=NAP+1). Bench (out_proj NAP=7, B=12288): FastMHL hard/ball = 21.2 ms, vs exp724 Tiny K-row dense backward = 34.5 ms (1.6x faster) and exp726 Tiny NAP+1 autograd save_memory = 41.8 ms (2.0x faster). Quality references @ 16k bs=24 ga=2: exp724=1.1936 (hybrid_smooth + K-row dense backward), exp726=1.1997 (hybrid_smooth + NAP+1 autograd). Tests: what does going from hybrid_smooth top-2 forward to hard 1-row forward cost in bpb at the same backward richness?
